title: Scientists Made a Living Frog Float in Mid-Air

scenes.text: Scientists made a living frog float in mid-air.
In the year 2000, a team at Radboud University in the Netherlands did it, led by Andre Geim.
There were no strings and no tricks, only a powerful magnet.
Everything contains water, and water is very slightly pushed away by magnets.
A strong enough magnet pushes back against gravity, and the frog just hangs there.
The team won an Ig Nobel Prize, and Geim later won a real Nobel for other work.

description:
Scientists made a living frog float in mid-air.
In 2000 a team led by Andre Geim at Radboud University used a powerful magnet. Water is slightly repelled by magnetic fields, and the frog is mostly water.
What would you float?
first_comment: A magnet beat gravity. What would you want to see float next?
